import { hasAdminSession } from "@/lib/auth/server"

export const Route = createFileRoute("/_admin")({ beforeLoad: async () => { if (!await hasAdminSession()) throw redirect({ to: {{FIZZYX_LOGIN_ROUTE}} }) }, component: AdminRoute })
